verdict.rationale: Greptile documents real first-party bulk actions within a single PR. A "Fix All" button sends every review issue at once, `/check-pr` fixes all review comments on a PR, and `greptile review --agent` outputs every catch together for an agent to apply. However, these batch actions are scoped to one PR's comments, not to many items across PRs or repos. missing for 10: bulk operations across multiple PRs or repositories (e.g., bulk resolve, re-review or configure), a documented bulk API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Fix All and check-pr flows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: A Fix All button in the review summary sends every issue at once.
Run `/check-pr` to fix all review comments on a PR
`greptile review --agent` outputs every greptile catch as raw text with a suggested fix for your agent to apply.
